results.content: We are on a mission to empower women founders in tech, breaking barriers, providing day-to-day support, and helping them scale their startups to success. 🎯 Our first action: launching the first French delegation of women tech founders at CES in at least 5 years — showcasing innovation, leadership, and the impact of female entrepreneurs on the global stage. We decided to create girls and take association to help women to get a better audience and visibility in the text industry. Did you know that there is only 1% of the funds that go to women that created a startup in the tech industry? Many thanks to Romain Futsch for sharing his feedback of CES expérience 🙏 Delighted to meet him in person there, to introduce the French delegation of women founders with Girls & Tech 🤩. Creating a new ecosystem which brings visibility to tech startups founded/cofounded by women is so important.
